inputs.text: The struggle inside the APC ahead of the 2027 elections shows how political influence can be concentrated in the hands of the wealthy, shutting working people and less powerful communities out of decisions that shape their lives. This is not just an internal party problem: it reflects deep inequality and a democratic system that needs to be opened up to real public participation rather than serving those with money.
